technical-summary: rad0044 (diagnostic, untested, experiment expert-route-record): --expert-route-record FILE records the expert ids each token's router chose per routed trunk layer (one-sequence prefill, tape off, incomplete marker, temp file + rename); manifest field engine.tuning.expert_route_record (contract amendment 21, generated files regenerated). rad0043 now labels every routed unit from its tensor name: the container numbers quantised experts compactly while tensors carry model ids, so experts after a protected one were filed one id too low per protected expert below.
